# apple_bundle_id_capability (Resource)

Enables a capability (app service) on a bundle ID. Enabling, changing or disabling a capability invalidates the bundle ID's provisioning profiles, which `apple_profile` then replaces. Import it with `<bundle_id>/<capability_type>`, where `<bundle_id>` is the bundle ID's App Store Connect ID or bundle identifier.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "apple_bundle_id_capability" "push" {
  bundle_id       = apple_bundle_id.app.id
  capability_type = "PUSH_NOTIFICATIONS"
}

resource "apple_bundle_id_capability" "icloud" {
  bundle_id       = apple_bundle_id.app.id
  capability_type = "ICLOUD"
  settings = {
    ICLOUD_VERSION = ["XCODE_6"]
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `bundle_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the bundle ID, e.g. `apple_bundle_id.app.id`. Changing it creates a new capability.
- `capability_type` (String) Capability to enable: `ACCESS_WIFI_INFORMATION`, `APPLE_ID_AUTH`, `APPLE_PAY`, `APP_GROUPS`, `ASSOCIATED_DOMAINS`, `AUTOFILL_CREDENTIAL_PROVIDER`, `CLASSKIT`, `COREMEDIA_HLS_LOW_LATENCY`, `DATA_PROTECTION`, `GAME_CENTER`, `HEALTHKIT`, `HOMEKIT`, `HOT_SPOT`, `ICLOUD`, `INTER_APP_AUDIO`, `IN_APP_PURCHASE`, `MAPS`, `MULTIPATH`, `NETWORK_CUSTOM_PROTOCOL`, `NETWORK_EXTENSIONS`, `NFC_TAG_READING`, `PERSONAL_VPN`, `PUSH_NOTIFICATIONS`, `SIRIKIT`, `SYSTEM_EXTENSION_INSTALL`, `USER_MANAGEMENT`, `WALLET`, `WIRELESS_ACCESSORY_CONFIGURATION`. Changing it creates a new capability.

### Optional

- `settings` (Map of Set of String) Settings of the capability, from setting key (`APPLE_ID_AUTH_APP_CONSENT`, `DATA_PROTECTION_PERMISSION_LEVEL`, `ICLOUD_VERSION`) to the options to enable (`COMPLETE_PROTECTION`, `PRIMARY_APP_CONSENT`, `PROTECTED_UNLESS_OPEN`, `PROTECTED_UNTIL_FIRST_USER_AUTH`, `XCODE_5`, `XCODE_6`), for example `{ ICLOUD_VERSION = ["XCODE_6"] }`. Changes are made in place. When unset, the provider does not manage the settings.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the capability.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = apple_bundle_id_capability.push
  identity = {
    bundle_id       = "F7F5U6U6H8"
    capability_type = "PUSH_NOTIFICATIONS"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `bundle_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the bundle ID.
- `capability_type` (String) Capability type, e.g. `PUSH_NOTIFICATIONS`.

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <bundle_id>/<capability_type>, where <bundle_id> is the App Store Connect ID
# or the bundle identifier.
terraform import apple_bundle_id_capability.push F7F5U6U6H8/PUSH_NOTIFICATIONS
terraform import apple_bundle_id_capability.push com.example.app/PUSH_NOTIFICATIONS
```
